dish.title: Taiwanese Three-Cup King Oyster Mushrooms with Jasmine Rice
dish.description: Thick king oyster mushroom rounds seared until deeply browned, then glazed in the classic three-cup sauce of toasted sesame oil, soy sauce, and Shaoxing wine with a heap of ginger, whole garlic cloves, and Thai basil. Served with jasmine rice and blanched bok choy.

recipe_version.title: Taiwanese Three-Cup King Oyster Mushrooms with Jasmine Rice
recipe_version.description: Thick king oyster mushroom rounds seared until deeply browned, then glazed in the classic three-cup sauce of toasted sesame oil, soy sauce, and Shaoxing wine with a heap of ginger, whole garlic cloves, and Thai basil. Served with jasmine rice and blanched bok choy.

ingredients.name: king oyster mushrooms
ingredients.preparation: cut into 1/2-inch rounds, faces scored in a crosshatch

ingredients.name: toasted sesame oil
ingredients.note: plus 1 tsp for the bok choy

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Rinse the rice. Cut the mushrooms into 1/2-inch rounds and score both cut faces in a shallow crosshatch. Slice the ginger into thin coins, peel the garlic, cut the scallions, and pick the basil leaves. Halve and rinse the bok choy.

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.body: Combine the rice and 2 cups water in a 2-quart saucepan, bring to a boil over high heat, cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes; then rest covered off the heat 5 minutes. This runs inside steps 3 to 5 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Sear the mushrooms
steps.body: Heat the neutral oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high. Lay the mushroom rounds in one layer and cook until deeply browned, about 4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.

steps.title: Toast the aromatics
steps.body: Lower the heat to medium and add 3 tbsp sesame oil. Cook the ginger until the edges curl and brown, about 2 minutes; add the garlic and chiles and cook 1 minute.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.body: Return the mushrooms, then add the Shaoxing wine, soy sauce, and brown sugar. Simmer, turning the mushrooms, until the sauce reduces to a sticky glaze, about 6 minutes. Off the heat, toss in the scallions and basil until the basil wilts.

steps.title: Blanch the bok choy
steps.body: At the start of step 3, set 6 cups water and 1 tsp salt to boil in a covered 4-quart pot over high heat. When it boils, blanch the bok choy 2 minutes, drain, and toss with 1 tsp sesame oil. This runs inside steps 3 to 5 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Fluff the rice and serve the mushrooms with their glaze, garlic, and basil beside the rice and bok choy.
